classification.difficultyReason: Form the photograph's area using the fixed poster area, then differentiate and classify the stationary point in the physical domain.

content.prompt:
A poster consists of a photograph bordered by a 5 cm margin.
The area of the poster is to be 400 cm².

spec.sourceRegion: Question 12, below the parts on the left

children.label: a
children.prompt: Show that the area of the photograph is given by the equation $A=500-10x-\frac{4000}{x}$.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Find the maximum area possible for the photograph.

answer.worked:
The photograph must have positive dimensions, so $x>10$ and $\frac{400}{x}>10$. Hence $10<x<40$.
$$\begin{aligned}A'(x)&=-10+\frac{4000}{x^2}\\0&=-10+\frac{4000}{x^2}\\0&=-10x^2+4000\\x&=20\quad(x>0)\\A(20)&=500-10(20)-\frac{4000}{20}\\A(20)&=100\text{ cm}^2\\A''(x)&=-\frac{8000}{x^3}\\A''(20)&=-1<0.\end{aligned}$$
Since $A''(x)<0$ throughout $10<x<40$, this stationary point gives the global maximum. The maximum photograph area is $100\text{ cm}^2$.
